name: Physical Security Policy
description: Defines how physical access to facilities and to areas holding protected information assets is authorised, granted, reviewed, and revoked, and how reliance on hosting providers is governed.
purpose: Give the physical access controls a documented basis, and make explicit which physical protections the entity operates itself versus relies on a subservice organization to operate.
scope_guidance: Should cover offices, server rooms, media storage, and any location where endpoints with access to protected information are used, plus the treatment of facilities operated by subservice organizations.

required_elements.element: Facilities and areas in scope, with sensitive areas distinguished from general access
required_elements.rationale: A single undifferentiated access tier over-grants by construction.

required_elements.element: Authorisation required before physical access is granted, and who may authorise it
required_elements.rationale: Mirrors the logical provisioning control and is assessed the same way.

required_elements.element: Revocation on termination or role change, with a committed timeframe
required_elements.rationale: The stated timeframe is the benchmark; without one, timeliness cannot be assessed.

required_elements.element: Periodic review of the access roster, with cadence and reviewer accountability
required_elements.rationale: The review control cannot be tested against an undefined cadence.

required_elements.element: Visitor handling, including registration and escort requirements for sensitive areas
required_elements.rationale: Visitors are the population most often outside the badge system entirely.
Routinely granted by exception and therefore unevidenced.

required_elements.element: Reliance on subservice organizations for facility controls, and the requirement to obtain and review their assurance reports
required_elements.rationale: For a hosted entity this is how CC6.4 is met, and leaving it unstated is why it is often missed.

required_elements.element: Handling of physical media in transit and at rest within facilities
required_elements.rationale: Connects physical security to the media sanitization control.

required_elements.element: Named policy owner, approval record, and review cadence
required_elements.rationale: An unapproved or undated policy is treated as a documentation deficiency.

approval_expectation.approver_role: Executive accountable for security (CISO or equivalent)

communication_expectation: Communicated to all personnel who enter facilities, and to whoever administers badge access, which is frequently outside the security function.
common_gaps: Policy assumes the entity operates its own facilities and is silent on hosted infrastructure, leaving CC6.4 apparently unaddressed for a cloud-native entity.
No committed timeframe for badge revocation, so overruns cannot be identified.
Server room access not distinguished from office access.

source_refs.supports: The criteria the controls this policy documents contribute to.
The required_elements model. SOC 2 prescribes no policy contents.

notes: A fully hosted entity still needs this policy; its content shifts from badge administration to subservice organization reliance and assessment.
